_meta.what: How navaids are said on the radio (owner: Tudor). A VOR/DME is spoken by its station name, not its letters: SFD = 'Seaford', so 'SFD1X' = 'Seaford one X-ray'. Five-letter fixes are spoken as written ('willo', 'timba') and are not listed. Used by the readback composer (speech) and the parser (controller says 'Seaford' -> SFD).
_meta.source: UK AIP ENR 4.1 navaid names (station names as used in RTF)
